The total amount for the proposed works in connection to the stadium is Rs 1,11,65,000 as per the latest revised estimate received from the Muzzafarnagar district administration. However, Rs 87,35,000 (as per the first estimate) has already been released at an earlier stage. Thus, the remaining Rs 24,30,000 is being sanctioned now from my end towards the completion of the necessary works of the stadium. The stadium will be located in the land of Junior High School, Sautu (block - Shahpur)
